proves.claim: On a fresh board with pace sprint, an item claimed, built and submitted with submit --no-next gets exactly one green screen job through the starter pullboard serve hands the board, with no accept given.

cli.sprint.screen-on-submit.why: Without it a sprint item could wait for a verdict like a steady one, with no screen to land on.

proves.claim: The same journey on a steady board makes no screen job and the item keeps its gate job as today.

cli.sprint.screen-steady-none.why: Sprint wiring must change nothing for steady boards.
